900.3.10(28).explanation: Exception RD 28 tightens the rules for detached houses: a 6.5 m height cap for flat roofs, a 16.5 m building-depth cap on narrower lots (with a small one-storey extension allowance), a gross floor area cap of 165 m2 plus 25% of the lot area (never above FSI 0.5, counting garages and void areas), side yard setbacks that grow with lot frontage, 3-car garages only on lots wider than 27.0 m, and a 46 m minimum lot depth on Ashley Park Rd. and two Royal York Rd. addresses.

900.3.10(101).explanation: Exception RD 101 keeps the lot frontage and lot area that existed in 2013 as the minimums, sets large setbacks from the original centrelines of Scarborough Golf Club Rd., Orton Park Rd. (22.0 m) and Markham Rd. (30.0 m), requires 1.2 m side yards and 5.7 m street-side yards, keeps garages at least 0.3 m from side lot lines, and has address-specific rules for 4 Par Avenue and for some Botony Hill Rd. and Madras Cres. lots under a former Scarborough by-law.
